dialogues.speaker: Burtsev
dialogues.text: The crystal ore shipments we're getting here at Sretomorozsk keep getting smaller, but the price just keeps going up. Something's off, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Burtsev
dialogues.text: Used to be that everyone would just close one eye and pretend nothing's wrong. I mean, no one wants to get into trouble for nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Burtsev
dialogues.text: But nobody's going to be able to feed themselves if this keeps up. No, we must do something about it. We must stage a protest!
